The current architecture ontology is the **generated production ontology** (`ontologies/software-architecture.ttl` from Trivyn v0.8.0), not the temporary hand-written stub.  
The stub was explicitly marked temporary and replaced as part of M2, and the active namespace is now `https://trivyn.io/ontologies/software/architecture/domain/` (with SHACL shapes in `ontologies/software-architecture_shapes.ttl`).
